releases.name: v1.7.0
releases.body:
- Added some missing timber hearth places
- Added custom icon support for [Solar Rangers](https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/solarrangers/) and [Symbiosis](https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/symbiosis/)
- Added translations (#5) (thanks @LOUDO56)
  - the french have invaded my mod

releases.name: v1.6.0
releases.body:
- Added custom icon support for [Band Together](https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/bandtogether/)
- Added handler callbacks to API (#4) by @qguv
  - Allows any modders to hook into my system and use my rich presence stuff to make mods that update other services (like for example a [Home Assistant](https://github.com/qguv/OuterWildsAtHome) 😉)

releases.body:
Added custom icon support for 
- [Mod Jam 3](https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/modjam3/)

I would add the other mods but they don't have ship log icons so oh well.
